The first tagged release of the Slop Goblin: a goblin that walks down your LinkedIn feed eating buzzwords, gets fatter with every bite, and spits the plain-English version back into the post.

**Install:** open [slopgoblin.pharmatools.ai](https://slopgoblin.pharmatools.ai) on a desktop browser and drag the green button to your bookmarks bar. No extension, no account, no network requests.

### What he does

- Eats **235 phrase patterns** and **83 buzzword families**, phrases first: “leverage synergies” is one bite, not two.
- **Translator mode** spits the plain English back into the sentence. “I’m thrilled to announce that” → “News:”. “A strategic rightsizing of our talent landscape” → “layoffs”.
- **Servings and girth.** Longer phrases are worth up to 3 servings; eight girth levels from *Peckish* to *Visible from space*.
- Opens a “… more” when slop is hiding behind it, scrolls on by himself, and pauses so you can read his work.
- **The bill:** press Esc for an itemised receipt you can save or copy as an image.
- Runs under strict Content Security Policy and Trusted Types, LinkedIn included. Nothing leaves your tab.

### For developers

- `dist/goblin.min.js` to put him on your own page, also on jsDelivr: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/nickjlamb/slop-goblin@v1.0.0/dist/goblin.min.js`
- `SlopGoblin.translate()` and `SlopGoblin.bites()` work in Node, and `examples/slopify.mjs` turns any text into plain English from the terminal.
- Translator, docs and build tests, plus an end-to-end smoke test in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit on every push.

### Fixed since the site went live on 28 September

- “an innovative solution” now becomes “a product”, not “an product”.
- “a unicorn hire” no longer becomes “a perfect hire hire”.
- “innovation” now reads “progress”, so “Innovation matters” stays grammatical.

### Assets

- `bookmarklet.txt`: the `javascript:` URL behind the green button, if you’d rather make the bookmark by hand.
- `goblin.min.js`: the embeddable build.

Full notes in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/nickjlamb/slop-goblin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
